name: Computer Name
purpose: Stores the hostname of the system in the ComputerName value, used to identify the machine on a network and correlate its identity across logs and other artifacts.
key_fields: ComputerName value - the configured hostname, effective from the next reboot
ComputerName\ActiveComputerName\ComputerName - the hostname actually in effect for the current boot session
normal_baseline: Hostname matches the organization's naming convention and asset inventory, and remains stable for the operational life of the system; ComputerName and ActiveComputerName values agree.
anomalies: Hostname changed shortly before or after other incident indicators, consistent with renaming a compromised host to evade endpoint-name-based detections, blocklists, or analyst attention
Hostname not matching the organization's naming convention, DNS record, or asset inventory for that machine
ComputerName and ActiveComputerName values differing at time of acquisition, indicating a rename was staged but had not yet taken effect (pending reboot) when the system was imaged
Mismatch between the ComputerName registry value and the hostname recorded in logs collected from the same system, indicating the value was changed after those logs were generated
anti_forensic_notes: A rename only fully takes effect after reboot; comparing ComputerName\ComputerName (pending/current) against ComputerName\ActiveComputerName (in effect for the current session) can reveal a rename made but not yet completed at the time of acquisition, which is otherwise easy to miss if only one of the two subkeys is checked.
interpretation: Hostname can facilitate correlation of log data and other artifacts that reference the machine by name. Because the value only changes fully after a reboot, compare ActiveComputerName (current session) against ComputerName (pending/next-boot) to detect an in-progress or recent rename.
